title: Pioneer Bancorp, Inc./MD 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: Pioneer Bancorp, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 22, 2026 announcing the expansion of its employee benefits services business through two acquisitions: Reiser Consulting Group, Inc. (Albany, NY) and Wyndham Benefits, LLC (Ballston Spa, NY), both effective April 20, 2026.
key_points: Pioneer Bancorp, Inc. is a financial institution headquartered in Albany, New York
The company announced two acquisitions effective April 20, 2026: Reiser Consulting Group, Inc. (owned by Theresa Reiser) and Wyndham Benefits, LLC (owned by Chris Goodness)
The acquisitions expand Pioneer's Employee Benefits division
Pioneer Bancorp trades as PBFS on The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC
The filing is signed by Patrick J. Hughes, Executive Vice President and CFO
This is a routine corporate announcement under Item 8.01 (Other Events)
